A rich cappuccino coat with a luxurious fur collar adds warmth and authority for an upscale restaurant setting. Gold earrings bring a touch of celebration without overpowering your presence, while woven brown pumps offer refined support for long evenings. A patterned saddle bag in soft white balances the darker tones and brings light to your ensemble.\", \"how_to_wear\": [\"Raise the coat’s collar to frame your face and lengthen your neckline under the warm lighting.\", \"Tuck the dress slightly at the waist if you prefer a more defined silhouette for seated events.\"], \"wrong_photos\": [], \"swap\": {}, \"named\": [{\"n\": \"#560·36\", \"what\": \"dress\"}, {\"n\": \"#197·04\", \"what\": \"coat\"}, {\"n\": \"#130·36\", \"what\": \"earrings\"}, {\"n\": \"#557·07\", \"what\": \"shoes\"}, {\"n\": \"#98·36\", \"what\": \"bag\"}], \"about_items\": [{\"n\": \"#560·36\", \"text\": \"This fitted grey dress features a soft, textured fabric with subtle metallic trim at the neckline and waist, creating quiet sophistication perfect for evening events.\"}, {\"n\": \"#197·04\", \"text\": \"The cappuccino coat is tailored with clean lines, deep pockets, and a plush fur collar that adds warmth and elegance—ideal for transitioning from outdoors to an upscale restaurant.\"}, {\"n\": \"#130·36\", \"text\": \"These delicate gold earrings shine subtly against the neutral tones of your outfit, offering just enough sparkle to celebrate without distracting from your presence.\"}, {\"n\": \"#557·07\", \"text\": \"Woven brown pumps with a pointed toe and slingback strap provide both style and comfort, letting you move gracefully through the evening while complementing the coat’s warm hue.\"}, {\"n\": \"#98·36\", \"text\": \"This patterned saddle bag in soft white introduces texture and lightness to the palette, balancing the darker tones of your coat and shoes while carrying essentials with effortless grace.\"}], \"day\": [\"As you return from illness to a joyful evening event at an upscale restaurant, this outfit honors both celebration and recovery—with breathable layers for summer warmth and structured pieces that feel supportive yet stylish. The tonal harmony between cappuccino, grey, and white reflects your desire to avoid intentional stylistic overreach while still feeling put-together.\"], \"palette\": [\"Metallic accents in gold harmonize with the subtle shimmer on your dress and add warmth to your skin tone. The analogous blend of brown, grey, and white creates a cohesive, grounded yet elevated look suitable for formal occasions.\"], \"body\": [\"This outfit gently flatters your straight figure by using defined waist trim on the dress and structured tailoring in the coat to create subtle visual definition. The A-line skirt of the dress flows gracefully over your hips without adding volume, while the coat’s clean lines elongate your silhouette. Woven pumps with a moderate heel add lift without compromising comfort during recovery.\"], \"shape\": [\"Your straight body benefits from the defined waist detail on the dress and the structured fit of the coat—both items introduce gentle shape definition without overwhelming your natural proportions.\"], \"ways_to_wear\": []}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":9152,"output_tokens":727},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
